knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

# Data for major group "Calanoids" in the lvl1 data (both main and excluded)
load("data/calanoid_trait_data.RData")
```

# Size distribution of Arctic Calanus spp
```{r}

calanus.size <- calanoid.level1.traitdata %>% 
  filter(genus %in% c("Calanus")) %>% 
  filter(scientificName %in% c("Calanus finmarchicus",
                               "Calanus glacialis",
                               "Calanus hyperboreus")) %>% 
  filter(traitName %in% c("bodyLength")) %>%  
  # Assume all non prosome length is body length
  mutate(sizeType = if_else(sizeType != "prosome length",
                                  "body length", "prosome length")) %>%
  mutate(sizeType = if_else(is.na(sizeType),
                                  "body length", sizeType)) %>%
  mutate(traitValue = as.numeric(traitValue)) %>% 
  mutate(lifeStage = factor(lifeStage,
                            levels = c("C1","C2","C3","C4","C5",
                                       "adult","female","male"))) %>% 
  mutate(sizeType = factor(sizeType,
                           levels = c("prosome length", 
                                      "body length")))


ggplot(calanus.size,
       aes(y = traitValue, x = scientificName,
           color = lifeStage, shape = sizeType)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21:24)) +
  facet_wrap(~sizeType)

ggplot(calanus.size,
         aes(x = traitValue, y = scientificName,
             color = scientificName))+
    geom_boxplot() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
  facet_wrap(~sizeType)

# Size at C4
calanus.size %>% 
  group_by(scientificName, lifeStage, sizeType) %>% 
  summarise(mean = mean(traitValue),
            sd = sd(traitValue),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop")
```



Visualize the trait distributions of carbon content, lipid content, size (length and weight), and respiration rates (active)
```{r}
resp <- calanoid.level1.traitdata %>% 
  filter(majorgroup == "Calanoid") %>% 
  filter(traitName %in% c("respirationRate_WSC_15C", 
                          "respirationRate_WSDW_15C",
                          "respirationRate_15C")) %>% 
  mutate(traitValue = as.numeric(traitValue)) %>% 
  filter(genus == "Calanus") %>% 
  filter(verbatimTemperature <= 2)

Calanus.respiration <- resp %>% 
  filter(genus == "Calanus") %>% 
  group_by(traitName, scientificName) %>% 
  summarise(mean = mean(traitValue),
            sd = sd(traitValue),
            n = n())
```



# Old figures
```{r}
copepods <- calanoid.level1.traitdata %>% 
  filter(majorgroup == "Calanoid") %>% 
  filter(traitName %in% c("carbonPDW","carbonPWW","dryWeightPWW",
                          "lipidPDW")) %>%  #"lipidPWW"
  mutate(traitValue = as.numeric(traitValue)) 


ggplot(copepods %>% 
         filter(genus %in% c("Calanus", "Neocalanus")), 
       aes(x = scientificName, y = traitValue)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_point(shape = 4) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +

  geom_boxplot() +

  coord_flip() +

```



# Get literature values of traits
- Body length
- carbon weight
- LipidPDW (note not carbon weight so likely higher?)
- Respiration rate? But have to convert to 0 degC, and from ul O2/h to ugC/day
```{r}
calanus.length <- calanoid.level1.traitdata %>% 
  filter(traitName == "bodyLength") %>%
  filter(scientificName %in% c("Calanus glacialis", "Calanus hyperboreus")) %>% 
  mutate(traitValue = as.numeric(traitValue)) %>% 
  filter(lifeStage %in% c("C3","C4","C5","male","female","adult"))


calanus.cweight <- calanoid.level1.traitdata %>% 
  filter(traitName == "carbonWeight") %>%
  filter(genus == "Calanus") %>% 
  filter(scientificName %in% c("Calanus glacialis", "Calanus hyperboreus")) %>%
  mutate(traitValue = as.numeric(traitValue)) 

# TODO Not exactly based on carbon like in this study
calanus.lipid <- calanoid.level1.traitdata %>% 
  filter(traitName == "lipidPDW") %>%
  filter(genus == "Calanus") %>% 
  # filter(scientificName %in% c("Calanus glacialis", "Calanus hyperboreus")) %>%
  mutate(traitValue = as.numeric(traitValue)) 

# The general calanoid carbon percent biovolume / dry weight
calanoids.cperc <- calanoid.level1.traitdata %>% 
  filter(traitName %in% c("carbonPWW","carbonPDW","dryWeightPWW",
                          "lipidPWW","lipidPDW")) %>% 
  mutate(traitValue = as.numeric(traitValue))

# rough average of all traits (not controlled by species)... the 0.2 * 0.45 is actually a good estimate
calanoids.cperc %>% 
  group_by(traitName) %>% 
  summarise(nindiv = n(),
            mean = mean(traitValue, na.rm = T),
            sd = sd(traitValue, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop")

# filter carbonPWW to not include large species (Neocalanus, Rhincalanus, Calanus fin/gl/hy ... pac&hel??)
calanoids.cpww <- calanoids.cperc %>% 
  filter(traitName == "carbonPWW") %>% 
  group_by(scientificName) %>% 
  summarise(nindiv = n(),
            mean = mean(traitValue, na.rm = T),
            sd = sd(traitValue, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(-mean)
calanoids.cpww <- calanoids.cpww %>% 
  mutate(scientificName = factor(scientificName,
                                 levels = unique(calanoids.cpww$scientificName))) %>% 
  # exclude pseudocalanus minutus because it seems like an outlier with n = 1
  filter(scientificName != "Pseudocalanus minutus")

# species average
mean(calanoids.cpww$mean)
# species average without large calanus...
notliipidcopes <- mean( (calanoids.cpww %>% 
         filter(scientificName %notin% c("Calanus hyperboreus", "Neocalanus cristatus",
                                         "Calanus pacificus",
                                         "Calanus helgolandicus", "Neocalanus plumchrus",
                                         "Calanus finmarchicus", "Calanus glacialis")))$mean)


ggplot(calanoids.cpww, aes(y = scientificName, x = mean)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = mean - sd, xmax = mean + sd)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 9, color = "pink") + # 20% x 45%
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(calanoids.cpww$mean), color = "red") + # species average
  geom_vline(xintercept = notliipidcopes, color = "blue") +
  xlab("Carbon % Wet Weight") +
  ylab("Calanoid copepods")
  
```
